result.summary: Found 3 visual issues, mainly a missing restaurant image and some content being clipped by fixed or horizontally scrollable areas.

issues.description: The main image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is missing and shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image style icon.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads correctly, provide a valid image URL, or use a polished fallback image instead of a generic placeholder.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed content; the pizza card is partially hidden behind the fixed nav area.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not covered by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrollable items are abruptly clipped at the right edge, including the category chip after 'Healthy' and the third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you'.
issues.suggestion: If this is intentional carousel behavior, add clearer spacing or snap points; otherwise adjust item widths/margins so visible text and cards are not cut off awkwardly.
